templates.pattern: In a class of [N] students, [P1] ranks [A]th from top. [P2] ranks [B]th from bottom. How many students are between [P1] and [P2]?
templates.explanation: Students between = N - rank_from_top([P1]) - rank_from_bottom([P2]) = [N]-[A]-[B]

templates.pattern: [P1] ranks [A]th from top and [B]th from bottom. [P2] ranks [C] places below [P1]. What is [P2]'s rank from the bottom?
templates.explanation: Total N = A+B-1. [P2] rank from top = A+C. From bottom = N-(A+C)+1 = B-C = [B]-[C]

templates.pattern: Train A departs at [AH]:[AM] and travels at [AS] km/h. Train B departs at [BH]:[BM] from the same station and travels at [BS] km/h in the same direction. After how many hours does Train B overtake Train A?
templates.explanation: Head start = AS*(BH-AH). Overtake time (after B departs) = Head start / (BS-AS) = [AS]*([BH]-[AH])/([BS]-[AS])

templates.pattern: In a race, [P1] finishes [A] seconds before [P2]. [P2] finishes [B] seconds before [P3]. [P3]'s time is [T3] seconds. What is [P1]'s time?
templates.explanation: [P2] time = T3-B. [P1] time = T3-B-A = [T3]-[B]-[A]

templates.pattern: [P1] is [A]th from top in a class. After [K] students above [P1] leave, [P1] becomes [B]th from top. How many students were originally above [P1] who did not leave?
templates.explanation: Remaining above = Original above - Left = (A-1) - K = [A]-1-[K]

templates.pattern: A project started on [DATE] of [MONTH]. It takes [WEEKS] weeks to complete. On what date does it end? (Assume 4 weeks = 28 days)
templates.explanation: End date = Start date + (Weeks × 7) = [DATE] + [WEEKS]×7 = [DATE+WEEKS*7] [MONTH]

templates.pattern: In a queue, [P1] is [A]th from front and [B]th from back. [P2] joins behind [P1] but in front of [C] others. What is [P2]'s position from the front?
templates.explanation: Total N = A+B-1. [P2] joins behind [P1], in front of C others → [P2] from front = N+1-C = A+B-C = [A]+[B]-[C]

templates.pattern: [P1] was born in year [BY]. [P2] is [K] years older than [P1]. [P3] is [M] years younger than [P2]. In year [CY], what is the age difference between [P1] and [P3]?
templates.explanation: [P3] is K-M years older/younger than [P1]. Age difference = |K-M| = |[K]-[M]|

templates.pattern: [P1] scores [S1] in round 1, [S2] in round 2, and [S3] in round 3. [P2] scores [T1],[T2],[T3] in the three rounds. The player with the higher total wins. Who wins and by how many points?
templates.explanation: [P1] total = S1+S2+S3. [P2] total = T1+T2+T3. Difference = |[P1]total - [P2]total|

templates.pattern: In a tournament with [N] players, [P1] beats everyone ranked below [A] (from top). How many players did [P1] beat?
templates.explanation: Players [P1] beat = Total - rank of [P1] = [N]-[A]

templates.pattern: A clock gains [G] minutes every [H] hours. It shows correct time at [SH]:[SM]. After [D] hours, what time does the clock show?
templates.explanation: Clock gains G*D extra minutes over D hours. Shown time = Actual time + G*D = [SH]:[SM] + [D]hrs + [D]*[G]min

templates.pattern: In a class, [P1] is [A]th from top. [P2] is [B]th from top. [P3] is exactly midway between [P1] and [P2]. What is [P3]'s rank from top?
[P1] starts a journey at [SH]:[SM] and travels at [SP] km/h. [P2] starts [K] hours later from the same point at [SP2] km/h in the same direction. At what time does [P2] catch [P1]?
templates.explanation: Time for [P2] to catch = SP*K/(SP2-SP). [P2] catches at time = SH+K + SP*K/(SP2-SP)

templates.pattern: In an exam, [P1] answered [Q1] questions in [T1] minutes. At the same rate, how many questions can [P1] answer in [T2] minutes?
templates.explanation: Rate = Q1/T1 questions per minute. In T2 mins = (Q1/T1)*T2 = ([Q1]/[T1])*[T2]

templates.pattern: Five persons [P1]-[P5] appeared for an interview on consecutive days. [P3] appeared on Wednesday. [P1] appeared [K] days before [P3]. [P5] appeared 2 days after [P3]. [P2] appeared just before [P5]. What day did [P4] appear?
templates.explanation: [P1]=Mon, ?=Tue, [P3]=Wed, [P4]=Thu, [P2]=Thu... [P5]=Fri, [P2]=Thu. [P4]=Tue

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] and [P2] interchange positions. [P1] was [A]th from left, now becomes [B]th from left. What was [P2]'s original position from the right?
templates.explanation: [P2]'s original position = [P1]'s new position = B from left. From right = N-B+1. But [P2] was at A's place originally, so [P2] was at B from left. [P2] original from right = N-B+1

templates.pattern: A series of tasks must be completed in order. Task 1 takes [T1] mins, Task 2 takes [T2] mins, Task 3 takes [T3] mins, Task 4 takes [T4] mins. Starting at [SH]:[SM], when is Task 3 completed?
templates.explanation: Task 3 completes at Start + T1 + T2 + T3 = [SH]:[SM] + [T1]+[T2]+[T3] mins

templates.pattern: [P1] is [A] years older than [P2]. [P3] is [B] years younger than [P1]. Sum of ages of [P2] and [P3] is [SUM]. What is [P1]'s age?
In a class ranking test, [P1] is [A]th, [P2] is [B]th, and [P3] is exactly between them at rank [C]th. What is the total number of students between [P1] and [P2]?
templates.explanation: Students between [P1] and [P2] = B-A-1 = [B]-[A]-1

templates.pattern: Event A ends at [AH]:[AM]. Event B starts [GAP] minutes after Event A ends and lasts [BD] minutes. Event C starts immediately after Event B. At what time does Event C start?
templates.explanation: Event C starts at AH:AM + GAP + BD = [AH]:[AM] + [GAP] + [BD] minutes

templates.pattern: In a class, [P1] is ranked [A]th from top. There are [K] students between [P1] and [P2]. [P2] is below [P1]. [P3] is [M] ranks above [P2]. What is [P3]'s rank from the top?
[P1] finishes a job in [D1] days. [P2] finishes the same job in [D2] days. They work together for [W] days. What fraction of the job is left?
templates.explanation: Work per day together = 1/D1+1/D2. Done in W days = W*(1/D1+1/D2). Left = 1 - W*(1/[D1]+1/[D2])

templates.pattern: In a competition, [P1] ranks [A]th. [P2] says '[P1] ranked [X] places below me.' [P3] says '[P2] ranked [Y] places above me.' What is [P3]'s rank?
templates.explanation: [P2] rank = A-X. [P3] rank = [P2]+Y = A-X+Y = [A]-[X]+[Y]

templates.pattern: A clock is [FAST] minutes fast. It shows [SH]:[SM]. What is the correct time?
templates.explanation: Correct time = Shown time - Fast minutes = [SH]:[SM] - [FAST] mins

templates.pattern: In a class of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from top. [K] students join the class, all ranked above [P1]. [M] students ranked above [P1] leave. What is [P1]'s new rank?
templates.explanation: New rank = A + Joined above - Left above = [A]+[K]-[M]
